en.text: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，我看见四位天使站在地的四角，执掌地上四方的风，叫风不吹在地上、海上，和树上。

zhTraditional.text: 此後，我看見四位天使站在地的四角，執掌地上四方的風，叫風不吹在地上、海上，和樹上。

en.text: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见另有一位天使，从日出之地上来，拿着永生 神的印。他就向那得着权柄能伤害地和海的四位天使大声喊着说：

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見另有一位天使，從日出之地上來，拿着永生上帝的印。他就向那得着權柄能傷害地和海的四位天使大聲喊着說：

en.text: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

zhSimplified.text: 「地与海并树木，你们不可伤害，等我们印了我们 神众仆人的额。」

zhTraditional.text: 「地與海並樹木，你們不可傷害，等我們印了我們上帝眾僕人的額。」

en.text: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

zhSimplified.text: 我听见以色列人各支派中受印的数目有十四万四千。

zhTraditional.text: 我聽見以色列人各支派中受印的數目有十四萬四千。

en.text: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

zhSimplified.text: 犹大支派中受印的有一万二千；吕便支派中有一万二千；迦得支派中有一万二千；

zhTraditional.text: 猶大支派中受印的有一萬二千；呂便支派中有一萬二千；迦得支派中有一萬二千；

en.text: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

zhSimplified.text: 亚设支派中有一万二千；拿弗他利支派中有一万二千；玛拿西支派中有一万二千；

zhTraditional.text: 亞設支派中有一萬二千；拿弗他利支派中有一萬二千；瑪拿西支派中有一萬二千；

en.text: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

zhSimplified.text: 西缅支派中有一万二千；利未支派中有一万二千；以萨迦支派中有一万二千；

zhTraditional.text: 西緬支派中有一萬二千；利未支派中有一萬二千；以薩迦支派中有一萬二千；

en.text: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

zhSimplified.text: 西布伦支派中有一万二千；约瑟支派中有一万二千；便雅悯支派中受印的有一万二千。

zhTraditional.text: 西布倫支派中有一萬二千；約瑟支派中有一萬二千；便雅憫支派中受印的有一萬二千。

en.text: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

zhSimplified.text: 此后，我观看，见有许多的人，没有人能数过来，是从各国、各族、各民、各方来的，站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕树枝，

zhTraditional.text: 此後，我觀看，見有許多的人，沒有人能數過來，是從各國、各族、各民、各方來的，站在寶座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手拿棕樹枝，

en.text: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

zhSimplified.text: 大声喊着说：「愿救恩归与坐在宝座上我们的 神，也归与羔羊！」

zhTraditional.text: 大聲喊着說：「願救恩歸與坐在寶座上我們的上帝，也歸與羔羊！」

en.text: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

zhSimplified.text: 众天使都站在宝座和众长老并四活物的周围，在宝座前，面伏于地，敬拜 神，

zhTraditional.text: 眾天使都站在寶座和眾長老並四活物的周圍，在寶座前，面伏於地，敬拜上帝，

en.text: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

zhSimplified.text: 说： 阿们！颂赞、荣耀、智慧、 感谢、尊贵、权柄、大力 都归与我们的 神， 直到永永远远。阿们！

zhTraditional.text: 說： 阿們！頌讚、榮耀、智慧、 感謝、尊貴、權柄、大力 都歸與我們的上帝， 直到永永遠遠。阿們！

en.text: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

zhSimplified.text: 长老中有一位问我说：「这些穿白衣的是谁？是从哪里来的？」

zhTraditional.text: 長老中有一位問我說：「這些穿白衣的是誰？是從哪裏來的？」

en.text: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

zhSimplified.text: 我对他说：「我主，你知道。」他向我说：「这些人是从大患难中出来的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白净了。

zhTraditional.text: 我對他說：「我主，你知道。」他向我說：「這些人是從大患難中出來的，曾用羔羊的血把衣裳洗白淨了。

en.text: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，他们在 神宝座前，昼夜在他殿中事奉他。坐宝座的要用帐幕覆庇他们。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，他們在上帝寶座前，晝夜在他殿中事奉他。坐寶座的要用帳幕覆庇他們。

en.text: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

zhSimplified.text: 他们不再饥，不再渴；日头和炎热也必不伤害他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他們不再飢，不再渴；日頭和炎熱也必不傷害他們。

en.text: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为宝座中的羔羊必牧养他们，领他们到生命水的泉源； 神也必擦去他们一切的眼泪。」

zhTraditional.text: 因為寶座中的羔羊必牧養他們，領他們到生命水的泉源；上帝也必擦去他們一切的眼淚。」
